note: Curated from published sources linked on each event. Marker positions are OpenStreetMap settlement nodes for the named places, not surveyed initiation points or mapped impact extents. Where published casualty figures conflict, no single figure is shown.

events.title: Mundakkai–Chooralmala landslides and debris flow
events.location: Punchirimattom, Mundakkai, Chooralmala and Vellarimala — Meppadi Grama Panchayat, Vythiri taluk
events.rainfall_reported: 204.5 mm in the first 24 h and 372.6 mm in the following 24 h (as reported in the source)
events.impact: Several hundred people killed and many missing; published death tolls differ between official releases — see source.

events.title: Puthumala landslide
events.location: Puthumala, Vellarimala village — Meppadi Grama Panchayat, Vythiri taluk
events.rainfall_reported: Triggered by ≈244 mm one-day rainfall (NRSC study as cited by source)
events.impact: 17 people killed, including 6 whose bodies were not recovered (Onmanorama; Springer chapter).

sources.label: Springer — The August 2019 Puthumala Landslide in Kerala, India

events.title: 2018 Kerala floods — Wayanad
events.location: District-wide (Wayanad was one of the hill districts isolated by landslides)
events.rainfall_reported: 2,676.8 mm vs normal 2,167.2 mm for 1 Jun – 17 Aug 2018 (+23.5%), per the cumulative rainfall table in the source
events.impact: Heavy rains caused severe landslides and left the district isolated (source). No point location — shown at the district centre.
events.position_basis: District-level event; marker placed at OSM node Kalpetta (district headquarters)
